mostWorthwhile.text: Following the sample from filtration through nutrient and water recovery was most worthwhile. The picture descriptions and brief explanations distinguish what stays in blood, what is recovered and what remains in the tubule.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was straightforward but less engaging; the named slots made both choices predictable.

surprise.text: The explanation that healthy kidneys normally recover almost all filtered glucose made the scale of recovery clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The item names, picture descriptions and goals gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter to see how the next body system connects, though this chapter's mostly predictable sequence offered limited decision-making.
